info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Loan Collateral Management API
info.description: The Loan Collateral Management API provides essential functionality for retrieving collateral details associated with loan applications. This endpoint allows clients to access specific collateral information by specifying the loan application identifier. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions, loan officers, and systems responsible for loan processing and assessment. By integrating this API, users can enhance their loan evaluation workflows and ensure accurate collateral data management.

get.summary: Retrieve Collaterals for a Loan Application
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to retrieve information regarding the collaterals associated with a specific loan application. It provides essential details that may be relevant for assessing the loan application status and evaluating the collateral's impact on the lending decision.

requestBody.description: A request to retrieve collaterals associated with a specific loan application. The request body can include optional parameters that may affect the response.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of collaterals associated with the loan application.
